crypto_keylength_justification: Verified TLS uses asyncpg0.31 and Python SSLContext(PROTOCOL_TLS_CLIENT), with TLS1.2 minimum by default. Inspected supported Python3.11/OpenSSL3.6.4 defaults use security level2 (at least112-bit strength/RSA2048). The application does not generate its own key sizes; operators can use stronger server keys. https://github.com/victron-venus/dbus-event-log/blob/codex/openssf-silver-evidence/docs/security-assurance.md
crypto_working_justification: SQLite is the default backend. Optional supported PostgreSQL deployments require SCRAM-SHA-256 and verified TLS (verify-full); TLS refuses untrusted certificates or plaintext fallback before credentials. The client retains asyncpg legacy MD5 compatibility if an operator selects an unsupported server authentication policy; this is explicitly disclosed, not claimed to be client-side SCRAM enforcement. Release signing uses maintained Cosign ECDSA P-256/SHA-256. https://github.com/victron-venus/dbus-event-log/blob/main/README.md#timescaledb-transport https://github.com/victron-venus/dbus-event-log/blob/main/docs/security-assurance.md
